parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, insulation housing, and structural integrity to the refrigerator, ensuring durability and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the doors, shelves, and internal components in place.

parts.name: Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, provides access to one of the main compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the refrigerator compartment, maintaining internal temperature and providing access to stored items.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinge axis, allowing it to swing open and closed smoothly.

parts.name: Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right door of the refrigerator, also made of stainless steel, typically covers the freezer or secondary compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer or secondary storage area, maintaining cold air retention when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door swings open and closed on its hinge, similar to the left door, allowing user access.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel, made of durable plastic, is located on the front of the refrigerator door.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to control temperature settings, ice/water dispensing, and other electronic functions.
parts.Movement_description: The control buttons or touch interface may have small actuation movements, but the panel itself remains fixed.
